title: Ujreyan Vaireyan Vich Sughra Karay Duawan
body:
​Ujreya Vaireyan Wich, Sughra Karay Duawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaja, Cheti Akbar, Chan Veer Teray Bajon, Ruk Jaanr Na Sawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Nanay Day Rozay Jakay, Deevay Jala Ke Rowaan
Sadmay Vichoreya Day, Saray Suna Ke Rowaan
Sunda, Kyun Nahi Nana, Beemar Diyan Arzaan, Mai Bhardiyan Hawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaala Jawani Maan Ay, Sughra Da Maan Jevain
Humshakl E Mustafa Da, Phupiyan Di Jaan Jevain
Cheti, Shakal Vakha Ja, Daadi Di Kasam Tenu, Mai Malliyan Nay Rawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhaina Baghair Veeran, Nai Sir Tay Sehray Launday
Laawun Jay Veer Sehray, Maa Jaiyan Nu Bulaunday
Menu, Veer Bula Lay, Mai Sehra Tenu Lawaan, Tay Shagun Manawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Fajre Main Dar Gayiyan Nay, Aya Ajeeb Khwaab Ay
Mitiyan Tay Bethi Vekhi, Asghar Di Maa Rubab Ay
Jhoolay Nu Agg Lag Gayi, Main Rondhiyan Takiyan Nay, Haye Behn Te Maava
<<DIVIDER>>
Touqeer Aina Kehkay, Sughara Zameen Te Jhan Gayi
Lagda Eh Sayedan Tay, Mushkil Hai Koi Ban Gayi
Katiyan Neher De Paasay, Hai Takiyan Ne Sughara Ne, Ghazi Diyan Baavan
